subject.title: fix(qqbot): allow approval buttons in direct C2C conversations

question: What identity should authorize a fallback approval callback in a QQBot C2C conversation when DM chat access is open or wildcarded?
rationale: The current configuration distinguishes permission to chat from permission to approve, and the patch assumes a direct-chat sender is the owner without any identity contract proving that assumption.

options.title: Require verified approver identity
options.body: Keep the authorization gate and revise the fix around an explicit allowFrom, configured approver, or verifiable owner-binding identity.

options.title: Keep current documented behavior
options.body: Close the PR and guide affected users to configure a concrete authorized QQ OpenID for approval-capable workflows.

options.title: Authorize every C2C sender
options.body: Deliberately treat any sender admitted to direct chat as an approval authority, accepting the resulting privilege expansion.

recommendation.title: Require verified approver identity
recommendation.body: Keep the authorization gate and revise the fix around an explicit allowFrom, configured approver, or verifiable owner-binding identity.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed, repaired, and merged the current QQBot fallback-approval authorization contract.
